question: What is the pettiest revenge you have ever pulled off?
story: A guy stole my lunch from the office fridge every single day for a month, so I got him promoted out of my life. I never caught him in the act, but my labeled sandwiches kept vanishing while he sat there chewing suspiciously. Confronting him did nothing. He just smiled and said, prove it. So I changed tactics completely. I started bringing in gourmet lunches, homemade pasta, fancy little desserts, all clearly labeled with my name. He ate every one. Then I casually mentioned to our boss that this guy had amazing taste and real leadership energy. I talked him up in every meeting for weeks. My boss loved the enthusiasm. Two months later, my sandwich thief got promoted to a different floor, in a different building, with his own private kitchen. My lunches have been safe ever since. Sometimes the best revenge is a glowing recommendation.
